reviewMethod: Independent Chat in a separate worktree copied pinned inputs, reviewed the exact delta, ran synthetic checks and returned evidence to Root. Root reviewed the report and source before accepting this limited scope.

retainedFailure.finding: P2: certificate validation accepted a symlink size inconsistent with its linkText when comparing the same malformed certificate to itself.
retainedFailure.impactLimit: No trusted-baseline bypass demonstrated. Certificate provenance remains the caller's responsibility.
retainedFailure.correction: One source line requires symlink size to equal Buffer.byteLength(mapping.linkText). Negative controls cover malformed expected, observed and both certificates.

finalVerification.scope: Separate local synthetic suites; not one combined suite or actual host proof.
finalVerification.reviewerHarnessCorrection: Initial verifier assumed CRLF although source used LF. Only verifier corrected before suites; candidate unchanged and the 39-case suite was not repeated.

contract.policy: No parent symlinks, target chains, dot segments or unconfigured path equivalence.
contract.crossPhaseInvariants: Paths, kinds, link text, canonical target, dev/ino/uid/gid/mode; symlink size/mtime/ctime.
contract.informational: Directory size/mtime/ctime may change without invariant drift.

limits: Injected filesystem/clock only; no actual host observation, mutation, SSH or GO.

No unit/process identity, installed/loaded source identity, PC readiness or production acceptance.
No host/lib integration, rollback wiring, envelope increase or phase credits approved.
